description: A feature flag in the recommendation service rerouted its cache-miss path to call product-catalog `GetProduct` with an empty request proto (no product ID) instead of `ListProducts`; the catalog returned gRPC `NOT_FOUND`, which was not caught in `get_product_list`, so `ListRecommendations` failed with gRPC `UNKNOWN` and the frontend surfaced HTTP 500s on `/api/recommendations`, while the catalog-hit branch returned an empty list (because `cached_ids` was never populated) which the frontend rendered as `partial_content`.
mechanism: The flag is read in at [`recommendation_server.py#L78`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/recommendation/recommendation_server.py#L78). When the flag is enabled, on every call the code branches into the cache-failure path: with probability 0.5 (and always on the first call, since `first_run=True`), it logs `get_product_list: cache miss` and then calls `GetProduct` with `demo_pb2.Empty()` (no product ID) at [`recommendation_server.py#L84`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/recommendation/recommendation_server.py#L84). The product-catalog server fails to look up an empty ID at [`main.go#L448`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/product-catalog/main.go#L448) and returns `StatusCode.NOT_FOUND` with message `Product Not Found: `. The exception propagates out of `get_product_list` (lines 85-87 never execute), through `ListRecommendations` at [`recommendation_server.py#L44`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/recommendation/recommendation_server.py#L44), and the frontend's gRPC client receives `StatusCode.UNKNOWN`, which the `/api/recommendations` route converts to HTTP 500. On the cache-hit branch (probability 0.5, never on the first call), the code returns the global `cached_ids` at [`recommendation_server.py#L92`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/recommendation/recommendation_server.py#L92), but `cached_ids` is permanently `[]` because every preceding cache-miss attempt fails on line 84 before reaching the assignment on line 86. `ListRecommendations` therefore returns zero product IDs and the frontend renders an empty recommendations section.

logs.name: Recommendation: Cache Miss (INFO)
logs.description: At 13:20:02 ET (17:20:02 UTC), ~2.4 seconds after the incident time, the recommendation service logged its first cache miss; 7 cache-miss entries were emitted between 17:20:02 and 17:29:59 UTC, confirming the recommendationCacheFailure flag is active.
logs.cause: Emitted at recommendation_server.py:83 inside the `if check_feature_flag("recommendationCacheFailure")` branch when `first_run=True` or `random.random() < 0.5`. The log is only reachable when the flag is on, so its presence is direct evidence of the flag being enabled. On this path the code then calls `product_catalog_stub.GetProduct(demo_pb2.Empty())` at line 84, which fails with NOT_FOUND because no product ID is provided, leaving `cached_ids` permanently empty.

logs.name: Recommendation: Cache Hit (INFO)
logs.description: At 13:21:17 ET (17:21:17 UTC), ~76 seconds after the incident time and ~74 seconds after the first cache miss, the recommendation service logged its first cache hit; 8 cache-hit entries were emitted between 17:21:17 and 17:26:40 UTC, confirming the recommendationCacheFailure flag is still active.
logs.cause: Emitted at recommendation_server.py:91 inside the `if check_feature_flag("recommendationCacheFailure")` branch when `first_run=False` and `random.random() >= 0.5`. This branch returns the global `cached_ids` without fetching from the catalog, but because every preceding cache-miss attempt fails on line 84 before reaching the assignment on line 86, `cached_ids` is always `[]`. ListRecommendations therefore returns zero product IDs on this path.

frontend.description: Recommendations section fails to load (~50% of requests, 100% on first call) because the recommendation service's cache-miss path calls GetProduct(Empty()) which returns NOT_FOUND.
frontend.trigger_condition: recommendationCacheFailure flag is on and random.random() < 0.5 (or first_run=True on the first call).
frontend.call_pattern: Single call: product_catalog_stub.GetProduct(demo_pb2.Empty()) — calls GetProduct with an Empty proto (no product ID) instead of ListProducts. The gRPC NOT_FOUND error propagates unhandled through get_product_list → ListRecommendations → frontend.
frontend.cause: On cache miss, the code calls GetProduct with an empty proto. The product-catalog service receives an empty ID, fails the DB lookup (getProductFromDB at main.go:320), and returns codes.NotFound with 'Product Not Found: '. The exception propagates out of get_product_list (lines 85-87 never execute), through ListRecommendations, and the frontend receives a gRPC UNKNOWN error which becomes a 500 on GET /api/recommendations.

frontend.description: Recommendations section shows no products (~50% of requests, never on first call) because cached_ids is permanently empty.
frontend.trigger_condition: recommendationCacheFailure flag is on, first_run=False, and random.random() >= 0.5.
frontend.call_pattern: Returns global cached_ids (line 92) which is always [] because GetProduct(Empty()) on the cache-miss path always throws before reaching the assignment on line 86. ListRecommendations returns an empty productIds list.
frontend.cause: On cache hit, the code returns cached_ids. But cached_ids is never populated — every cache-miss attempt fails on line 84 before reaching lines 86-87. So ListRecommendations returns zero product IDs, the frontend's Promise.all at recommendations.ts:20-21 resolves to an empty array, and the response is 200 with no recommendations. The user sees an empty recommendations section rather than an error.
